brand.name: Perspicil
brand.status: Product brand; legal entity and trademark review require founder/counsel input
brand.title: Perspicil | Private Company Intelligence
brand.description: Private company financial health research with evidence-weighted scoring, watchlists, reports, and peer comparison.

stage: Research MVP; release branch verified in CI, backend activation pending

capabilities.name: Public evidence collection
capabilities.note: Implemented; availability varies by source and entity. Deployment not verified.

capabilities.name: Entity resolution
capabilities.note: Ambiguous and non-company entities are gated; not an authoritative registry for all companies.

capabilities.name: Evidence-weighted research score
capabilities.note: Not a credit rating or default probability; empirical outcomes not validated.

capabilities.name: Saved companies and history
capabilities.note: Individual data and isolated organization-owned resources.

capabilities.name: CSV bulk screening
capabilities.note: Workspace queue supports 1,000 rows, durable workers, CSV export and idempotency.

capabilities.name: Weekly reevaluation
capabilities.note: Weekly worker scheduler, in-app events and configured email/webhook delivery; hosting activation pending.

capabilities.name: Customer API
capabilities.note: Organization-scoped revocable keys, 10,000 lifetime new-job quota and shared 120/minute read/request limit.

capabilities.name: Team workspaces
capabilities.note: Owner/admin/member roles, invitations, transfer, isolated resources, optional enforced MFA.

capabilities.name: Licensed commercial evidence
capabilities.note: Contracts, granular permissions, retention operations and vendor access required.

capabilities.name: Consented accounting evidence
capabilities.note: Tenant-bound permissions, expiry, encrypted storage and revocation; vendor integration remains disabled.

capabilities.name: Predictive default probability
capabilities.note: No labeled outcome validation; not available.

capabilities.name: Company correction review
capabilities.note: Authenticated report disputes, operator review with append-only review history.
